body:
XL original-model checkpoint (ROOT, with the existing terrain and identity agents): last verified fixed cohort remains 521 = 234 installed + 287 remaining; this checkpoint adds zero installations.

Pushed commit c9cbc9e5dc36f6d796cd058871cc1db6794d70ea preserves PolyU's official campus POI records, linked labelled photographs and exact current source attributes. Pinned Neon completed source-only job 5e9dbe7ea9b7f9017f977819d3f2060354474a079a57d85faf9dd9f9edb467f6 and all 23 evidence references were independently read back and hash checked. Retained actor 305793 is source-typed Podium with six footprint rings; its OSM-derived library name alone does not prove an unrelated library-tower collision. Exact interface identity and physical installation acceptance remain unapproved.

Upton's saved-union v2 worker exited 1 before any finite chunks: its complete-ground selector requires exact rational coordinates, but the caller supplied floats. All 11 resources released; producer PIDs are absent. ROOT fully reviewed the distinct v3 Fraction(float) adapter; all 10 code and 47 input pins match. Only bounded read-only import/schema/selector preparation is authorised so far; no changed geometry, relaxed policy or installation credit.

Citywalk finished all three 41,277-face numerical passes on its original worker and is assembling/freezing results; terminal acceptance and final evidence readback remain pending. Southside's unchanged private terrain constructor remains live; ROOT observed the same owned child doing CPU work. No optimisation assets or AI model geometry were created. Next: verify terminal outputs, resolve genuine source/placement gaps, install only passing originals, and commit/push each installation.
